text: Pharmacology, relying on basic medical knowledge such as physiology, biochemistry and pathology, not only studies the effects of drugs on biological bodies and their mechanisms of action, that is, pharmacodynamics, but also investigates the changes and patterns of drugs under the influence of the body, that is, pharmacokinetics. The research aims to fully leverage the therapeutic effects of drugs, enhance the safety and rationality of clinical medication, provide a scientific basis for rational clinical drug use, and also offer theoretical support and experimental data for new drug development and other purposes.
